==Russian==

===Etymology===
From {{af|ru|[[дорогой|дорог(о́й)]]|-у́ша}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|дорогу́ша}}

===Noun===
{{ru-noun+|дорогу́ша|a=an|g=mfbysense-an|dim=дорогу́шечка}}

# {{lb|ru|familiar}} [[my]] [[dear]], [[darling]] (a term of address for both men and women)

====Usage notes====
May be considered old-fashioned, ironic or rude, especially when a speaker addresses people that they don't know well.

====Declension====
{{ru-noun-table|дорогу́ша|a=an}}

====See also====
* {{l|ru|ми́лочка}} {{q|a simalar term for addressing women, more rude}}
